newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixes at fresh low since Dec 1985.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixes at fresh low since Dec 1985.

text.p: Gold bullion fixed at $318.75 per ounce on Monday, to record a fresh low fixing since December 1985.
On Friday it fixed at $324.45, which was then its lowest price in the near 12 years to December 1985.
"It would take a Martian to be bullish for gold now," said precious metals analyst Andy Smith at Union Bank of Switzerland.
Gold has lost about 13 percent of its value so far this year under threat of selling by central banks, which hold around 30,000 tonnes of the metal in their reserves, traders said.
The latest selling spree followed an announcement last Thursday by the Reserve Bank of Australia that it had sold 167 tonnes, or nearly two-thirds, of its gold reserves over the past six months.
"The price is still under a lot of pressure. At 12-year lows nobody knows what will happen next," one dealer said.
